note: LOW/MID/HIGH are researched ranges, not quotes. Every line lists its sourcing basis. Alberta-first: every line item has an in-province supply path.

lineItems.label: Land (1-5 acres)
lineItems.basis: Live realtor.ca listings Aug 2026: Lac Ste. Anne County $75K-$199K bare parcels (75 active listings); Sturgeon 38 listings pricier; Leduc dearest

lineItems.label: Screw-pile foundation (16-24 piles)
lineItems.basis: $300-$900/pile installed, Edmonton screw-pile firms; winter-installable, no 28-day cure; concrete alternative $25K-$45K

lineItems.label: SIP shell kit + erection
lineItems.basis: Complete engineered shell $50-$100/sqft small-build premium; EcoPrefabs 448sqft weathertight anchor $28K; quotes required from EnerSmart/Insulspan/Premier - none publish pricing
lineItems.ownerNote: 2-3 people + telehandler, small-format panels only; shell in days

lineItems.label: Metal roof, triple-pane windows, doors, siding
lineItems.basis: Metal roof $8-15/sqft; triple-pane $900-$1,800/window x ~8 (zone 7A spec); Lux Calgary / All Weather Edmonton / Duxton Winnipeg

lineItems.label: Interior fit-out (kitchen, bath, drywall, floor)
lineItems.basis: Drywall REQUIRED over interior SIP faces (15-min fire barrier); IKEA-grade kitchen $6-18K; 3-pc bath $12-25K

lineItems.label: HRV, plumbing, electrical, wood stove + WETT
lineItems.basis: HRV mandatory in airtight SIP home $3.5-7.5K; homeowner may pull own electrical/plumbing permits on own residence; stove installed $2.5-4K + WETT $150-400
lineItems.ownerNote: Homeowner permits legal for own residence; solar/battery wiring is NOT (CEC s.64 licensed contractor)

lineItems.label: Off-grid solar 8-12kW + 20-40kWh LiFePO4 + generator
lineItems.basis: Edmonton Dec yield ~1.3 kWh/kW/day forces oversizing; LFP $550-800/kWh; auto-start generator $3-8K NOT optional; Dandelion/Kuby/SkyFire Edmonton

lineItems.label: Water: buried cistern (or well)
lineItems.basis: Cistern $8-15K installed + hauling ~$200-350/mo opex; well $10-18K at $45-115/ft where aquifer reliable; AWG rejected as primary (see feasibility)

lineItems.label: OPTIONAL: AWG summer drinking-water module
lineItems.basis: GENNY-class 10-20 L/day Jun-Sep only; 0 L/day outdoors Nov-Mar (physics); honest positioning: supplement, never primary

lineItems.label: Private sewage (septic field or Ecoflo biofilter)
lineItems.basis: Certified installer REQUIRED by law (no DIY); conventional $10-25K; Ecoflo peat/coco biofilter ~$8-10K unit + tanks/dispersal = eco headline option; design $1.8-3K + permit $500-1200

lineItems.label: Wood-fired hot tub + deck
lineItems.basis: AlumiTubs -44C tested $10-13.5K / Backcountry Recreation from ~$4K / Goodland design-tier; deck $25-45/sqft, no permit under 24in height

lineItems.label: Permits, design, engineering, insurance
lineItems.basis: Dev permit ~$231 (Leduc Cty); building+trade permits $1.5-7K; Owner Builder Authorization $750; drafting $1.2-2.7K; truss P.Eng in truss package (STANDATA 23-BCB-002); course-of-construction insurance $1.5-3K

totalsRule: totals = sum of non-optional line items x (1 + contingencyPct); optional lines (awgSupplement) excluded; land excluded from ex-land totals. Totals below are COMPUTED from the lines above - if you change a line, recompute.

builderComparison.basis: Same home builder-delivered ex-land at $250-450/sqft hard + 25-40% soft; owner-builder saves 30-40% ($150-250K) for 12-24 months of labour

regulatory.architectBasis: Alberta Architects Act exempts 1-4 unit dwellings of any size; Part 9 NBC 2023 Alberta Edition governs
engineerTouchpoints: Roof trusses (P.Eng authentication mandatory since 2026-03-01, STANDATA 23-BCB-002, supplied by truss manufacturer)
SIPs via CCMC listing (Insulspan CCMC 13016-R) or P.Eng stamp
Foundations outside Part 9 prescriptive tables (screw piles)
regulatory.minDwellingSize: DISTRICT-level, not county: Lac Ste. Anne Agricultural 592 sqft; its Country Residential 1,076 sqft - verify parcel district before purchase

holdback.basis: Alberta Prompt Payment and Construction Lien Act statutory holdback - modeled in the AuraBuildEscrow contract
